name: Unbreakable Resolve

source.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

text:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You fail a Will save.

---
The experience of coming back after death has granted you a strong sense of resolve; devilish words, slick spells, and conniving trickery can't easily catch you unprepared. Reroll the triggering save, using the second result only if it's better.
